summary: 25 most valuable features for djsugar-next parity: 1) Stem separation (Demucs 4-stem) with per-stem gain/mute/solo/FX/instant doubles, 2) Dynamic beat grid with tempo sections, 3) Phrase detection + phrase-aware automix, 4) GPU waveform rendering (wgpu), 5) Ableton Link + MIDI clock, 6) CLAP/VST3/AU plugin host with crash isolation, 7) Pluggable library sources (Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Serato, Traktor, VirtualDJ, iTunes), 8) USB device manager (format, backup, sync, export to player formats), 9) Automix with phrase-aware transitions, 10) Color preview waveform (RGBH), 11) Groove Box/Beat Lab with drum capture + Plaits synthesis, 12) Sampler sequencer (step lanes + macro lanes), 13) Looper (8 loops/deck, overdub, quantized), 14) Broadcast (Icecast/Shoutcast) + Mixcloud upload + Now Playing, 15) Timecode/DVS support, 16) OSC + Web remote, 17) JavaScript/Lua scripting for controllers, 18) Touch layout profile + gestures, 19) Theming/skinning with token system, 20) Android native app, 21) Raspberry Pi optimized build, 22) Guided tour + tutorials, 23) Similar tracks recommendation, 24) Word-level lyric timing + karaoke, 25) Grid editor with UNDO/REDO + Analysis Lock, 26) Edit mode (timeline arranger, EDL, render WAV)
